about.heading: ABOUT ME
about.heroDescription: 我是一位透過設計、影像與聲音探索故事的創作者。
about.storyBody:
創作，從童年就已經是我生活的一部分。

成長過程中，我深受父親對攝影及繪畫的熱愛所影響。看著他用相機捕捉日常、用畫筆勾勒感受，讓我很早就學會觀察細節，並與說故事建立起連結。除了攝影，我也喜歡畫畫、動手創作，並經常參觀展覽，這些經驗逐漸形塑了我對視覺表達與美感的理解。

除了視覺，我也對聲音有著極大的熱情。我熱愛唱歌，從小時候的小提琴到長大後自學吉他，無論是旋律的流動，還是周遭環境裡的細微聲響，都讓我著迷。這份熱愛磨練了我對聲音與節奏的敏銳度，聲音裡的情緒起伏，就和鏡頭下的光影一樣，深刻形塑了我感受世界的方式。
about.philosophyIntro: 對我來說，每一種媒介都有自己的語言。
about.philosophyClosing: 我相信創作不只是做出好看的作品，而是把經驗與情感轉化成能讓人產生共鳴的東西。
about.beyondBody:
我喜歡旅行，探索陌生的地方。

在澳洲生活與工作的經驗，讓我有機會體驗不同的文化與環境。這些經歷開拓了我的視野，也成為創作靈感的重要來源。

每一趟旅程，都讓我用不同的方式觀看世界，發現新的故事。
about.ctaText: 感謝你花時間走進我的世界。下一個精彩的故事，讓我們一起寫。

about.heading: ABOUT ME
about.heroDescription: I am a creator who explores stories through design, image, and sound.
about.storyBody:
Creativity has been an integral part of my life since childhood.

Growing up, I was deeply influenced by my father’s passion for photography and painting. Watching him capture fleeting moments through the lens and translate his feelings onto canvas taught me to observe subtle details and connect through storytelling. Beyond photography, I naturally gravitated toward drawing, hands-on crafting, and visiting exhibitions—experiences 
that gradually shaped my visual intuition and aesthetic sensibilities.

Parallel to the visual world, I hold an equal fascination with sound. Singing, learning the violin as a child, and later teaching myself the guitar nurtured a sharp ear for acoustic nuance—from melodic flows to the subtle ambient textures of daily life. This sensitivity to rhythm and resonance, much like light and shadow in a frame, fundamentally defines how I feel, perceive, and interpret the world around me.
about.philosophyIntro: To me, every medium has its own language.
about.philosophyClosing: I believe creativity is not only about creating beautiful work, but about transforming experiences and emotions into something people can connect with.
about.beyondBody:
I love traveling and exploring unfamiliar places.

Living and working in Australia gave me the chance to immerse myself in different cultures and environments. Those experiences broadened my perspective and remain a vital source of creative inspiration.

With every trip, I see the world through a different lens and uncover new stories.
about.ctaText: Thank you for exploring my space. Let’s create the next compelling chapter together.
